mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHATROOMS WHERE (CHATUSER1_ID = LEAST(#{u1}, #{u2}) AND CHATUSER2_ID = GREATEST(#{u1}, #{u2})) AND CHATROOM_STATUS IN ('P','A') ORDER BY (CASE CHATROOM_STATUS WHEN 'A' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), CREATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CHATROOMS WHERE CHATROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND (CHATUSER1_ID = #{userId} OR CHATUSER2_ID = #{userId})

SELECT r.CHATROOM_ID AS roomId, CASE WHEN r.CHATUSER1_ID = #{userId} THEN r.CHATUSER2_ID ELSE r.CHATUSER1_ID END AS otherUserId, lastMsg.MESSAGE AS lastMessage, lastMsg.CREATED_AT AS lastCreatedAt, NVL(unread.CNT, 0) AS unreadCount FROM CHATROOMS r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.* FROM CHAT_MESSAGE c1 JOIN ( SELECT CHATROOM_ID, MAX(MESSAGE_ID) AS MAX_ID FROM CHAT_MESSAGE GROUP BY CHATROOM_ID ) m ON c1.CHATROOM_ID = m.CHATROOM_ID AND c1.MESSAGE_ID = m.MAX_ID ) lastMsg ON lastMsg.CHATROOM_ID = r.CHATROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CHATROOM_ID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE IS_READ = 'N' AND SENDER_ID <> #{userId} GROUP BY CHATROOM_ID ) unread ON unread.CHATROOM_ID = r.CHATROOM_ID WHERE (r.CHATUSER1_ID = #{userId} OR r.CHATUSER2_ID = #{userId}) AND r.CHATROOM_STATUS IN ('A','P') ORDER BY NVL(unread.CNT,0) DESC, lastMsg.CREATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST
